links.outcome: Concordance of ChatGPT-4 therapeutic recommendations with EAU guidelines-based urologist plans
links.effect: Overall agreement poor (Cohen's K=-0.06); first-time BCa K=0.23; MIBC K=0.88; recurrent K=-0.24; II look TURBT K=-0.6; aligned with guidelines for early radical cystectomy in only 3 of 21 cases.
links.quote: Overall agreement between urologist and ChatGPT recommendations was poor (Cohen's K=-0.06).

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of ChatGPT-4's concordance with EAU guidelines and urologists' treatment recommendations using 219 clinical/pathology vignettes.
